title: Enterprise Account Executive - Financial Services
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Financial Services: the banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, and wealth managers people trust with their money, their families, and their futures. These institutions win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere. Their customers increasingly expect to talk, not type, whether they’re checking a balance, disputing a charge, filing a claim, or asking about a loan. Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to institutions reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale. In this role you will: Win net-new logos and drive ElevenAgents deal volume. These are the two metrics that define success in this role Be able to balance a diverse pipeline of large financial institutions who require white glove experience with medium sized regional clients who require speed to close Partner with the Enterprise Sales Lead to turn warm introductions into qualified opportunities and closed deals Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in customer-facing and internal workflows. Our public use cases include account inquiries, payment support, fraud triage, loan origination, claims processing, collections, and compliance verification. Others include caller verification, onboarding, policy servicing and renewals, and contact center coaching Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in AI governance and model risk Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (CX and Contact Center Operations, Digital and Product, Technology, and Risk, Compliance, Legal, and InfoSec), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across lines of business Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to solution high-impact use cases, manage a successful Proof of Value, guide customers through model-risk, security, and architecture review, and set them up to scale in production Partner closely with Legal teams to drive strategic, fast-moving negotiations Serve as a trusted advisor on generative AI and voice, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our Financial Services positioning, messaging, and references Requirements At least 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms Financial services experience (banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, payments) is preferred but not required. title: Technical Outsource Manager (m/w/d)
description: Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Technical Outsource Manager (m/w/d) in Berlin. Unser Team bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit für einen Technischen Outsourcing-Manager (m/w/d), der als Vermittler zwischen unserem High-Tech-Kunden und den Remote-Teams in Bulgarien fungieren wird. Als Technischer Outsourcing-Manager schaffen, pflegen und erweitern Sie Geschäftsbeziehungen, indem Sie langfristige Beziehungen zu unseren Kunden aufbauen und verwalten. Sie fungieren als Bindeglied zwischen dem Kunden und dem Team in Bulgarien und unterstützen diese mit Ihrem technischen Wissen und umfassenden Erfahrungen. Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner werden Sie neue Leads managen und diese zu Nearshoring-Projekten entwickeln; Engineering-Anfragen diskutieren und Einblicke aus verschiedenen Kundenabteilungen einbringen. Sie werden den Kunden regelmäßig besuchen. Sie sind für Kundenbeziehungen verantwortlich und der Hauptansprechpartner für unsere Kunden bei den betreffenden Projekten in einem komplexen, anspruchsvollen und sich häufig ändernden Umfeld. Sie haben ein Auge dafür, Abweichungen in Qualität, Lieferzeit und Budget zu erkennen, diese anzusprechen und zu managen. Um das Bewusstsein für die Bedürfnisse der Kunden zu schaffen, bringen Sie diese „Signale“ und das Kundenfeedback in das Team ein. Sie gewährleisten eine bidirektionale Kommunikation und managen Eskalationen vom Team in Sofia zum Kunden. Ihre Erfahrung bringt Verantwortung und Eigenverantwortung in die Projekte, was sicherstellt, dass unsere Lösungen nachhaltig und umfassend in die Organisationen unserer Kunden eingebettet sind. Zusätzliche Verantwortung: Kommunikation mit Kunden auf mehreren Ebenen; mit technischen Spezialisten, Projektmanagern, Fachleitern und zugewiesenem Personal, das in die Projekte involviert ist Teilnahme an Vor-Ort-Meetings mit dem Kunden Abstimmung der Anforderungen (funktional und technisch), Projektplanung, Nachverfolgung und Berichterstattung Technische Beratung in Ihrem Fachgebiet Fungieren als (technische) Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden und den Remote-Entwicklungsteams Mitwirkung an der Erstellung und Abstimmung der (langfristigen) Outsourcing-Produkt-Roadmap/Vision mit relevanten Stakeholdern Schließen von Lücken, die durch Nearshoring entstehen, und Entwicklung struktureller Lösungen Erstellung von Budgets für Ingenieurvorschläge Initiierung von Folgeprojektverkäufen und Verwaltung zusätzlicher Budgets Identifizierung neuer Leads in Ihrem Tätigkeitsbereich Entwicklung Ihres Wissens, um ein voll engagiertes und respektiertes Teammitglied zu werden Fähigkeiten: Konzeptionelles Denken und die Fähigkeit, die Auswirkungen zu analysieren, (High-Level) Designs zu erstellen, die Arbeit geplanter Funktionen vorzubereiten und herunterzubrechen Regelmäßige Abstimmung mit dem Kunden über Prioritäten, Umfang und Abhängigkeiten (zwischen Softwareteams) Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen: Master- oder Bachelor-Abschluss in einem technischen Bereich Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten über Funktionen und Teams hinweg, sowohl nach oben als auch nach unten in der Befehlskette Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Softwareentwicklungsumgebung (z.B. als Softwarearchitekt und/oder Softwareingenieur) Tiefgehende Erfahrung im Entwurf und Schreiben von Software Erfahrung in der Leitung von SCRUM-basierten Projekten Erfahrung mit SAFe ist von Vorteil Erfahrung mit Outsourcing ist von Vorteil Erfahrung in einem High-Tech-Embedded-Umfeld ist von Vorteil Schnelle Auffassungsgabe, um mit dem Kunden und dem technischen Team auf Augenhöhe zu arbeiten Starke Verhandlungsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, proaktiv mit Konflikten und Eskalationsmethoden umzugehen Sprachniveau: Deutsch C1, Englisch B2 Sie sind: Ein hochmotivierter Selbststarter mit einer Leidenschaft, Ergebnisse zu erzielen Ein Teamplayer In der Lage, häufig vor Ort beim Kunden zu arbeiten Bereit, regelmäßig nach Bulgarien zu reisen Wir bieten: Eine herausfordernde Position in einem High-Tech-Umfeld mit hoher Kundenintimität, basierend auf einer langfristigen Beziehung Betriebsrente Mobilitätskonzept (wähle zum Beispiel zwischen Tankgutschein, Deutschlandticket, Rollernutzung und anderen Möglichkeiten) Monatliche Company Days für fachlichen und persönlichen Austausch Regelmäßige Team Events Buddy Programm (dein persönlicher Buddy steht dir während des gesamten Onboardings zur Seite. Er ist deine Bezugsperson und soziales Bindeglied zum Unternehmen) Individueller Fortbildungs- und Entwicklungsplan 30 Urlaubstage Softdrinks & Feierabendbier gehen auf uns! Wasser und Kaffee gibt es aber natürlich auch ;) Über uns Als Teil der niederländischen ICT Group, trägt ICT Digital Solutions seinen Teil dazu bei, die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen smarter zu machen. Die ICT Group verteilt sich auf 14 Standorte in unterschiedlichen Ländern mit mehr als 2.500 Mitarbeitern. ICT Digital Solutions verfügt sowohl über umfangreiche Multi-Domain-Expertise als auch über tiefgreifende Branchenkenntnisse. Die Integration dieser Stärken in überzeugende technologische Lösungen versetzt uns in eine einzigartige Position, um unseren Kunden zu helfen, ihre Geschäftsprozesse effizienter, flexibler, einfacher, sicherer und – als Ergebnis – nachhaltiger zu gestalten. Wir bieten nicht nur Software-Beratung, sondern auch individuelle und maßgeschneiderte Software-Entwicklungsleistungen sowie eigene „out of the box“ Software-Lösungen für die digitale Transformation, insbesondere IoT an. title: Werde Andockoffizier – als Account Executive Information Security (m/w/d)
description: Remote-first, Büro in Karlsruhe | ab sofort | unbefristet ab Tag eins 4.500–7.000 EUR Bruttofixgehalt pro Monat. Deine Einordnung im Fixgehaltsband richtet sich nach deiner relevanten Erfahrung und der Abschlussverantwortung, die du übernimmst. Warum deine Mission zählt Informationssicherheit entscheidet heute darüber, ob ein Unternehmen handlungsfähig bleibt. Unsere Kunden sind Mittelständler und KRITIS-Organisationen, die NIS2 und steigende Anforderungen nicht als Formular sehen wollen, sondern als Schutz, der trägt. Als Andockoffizier bist du die Person, bei der aus Interesse eine Entscheidung wird. Du führst Strategiegespräche mit Geschäftsführung und IT-Leitung, schaffst Entscheidungssicherheit und bringst die Beauftragung über die Ziellinie. Andocken heißt: zwei Seiten verbinden sich fest. Genau das ist deine Aufgabe. Du verkaufst nicht, was ein Hersteller vorgibt. Du verkaufst, was unsere Crew wirklich umsetzt, und du kannst es auch in einem Jahr noch vertreten. Was dich erwartet Deine Rolle an Bord Du übernimmst vorqualifizierte Bedarfe. Erstkontakt und Terminierung liegen bei einer Agentur oder einem anderen Crew-Mitglied, das Mehrwertgespräch führt unsere Fachseite. Wenn ein Gespräch bei dir ankommt, ist der Bedarf geprüft. Deine Aufgabe beginnt dort, wo es um die Entscheidung geht. Strategiegespräche führen Problem-, Ziel- und Nutzenbild gemeinsam mit dem Kunden schärfen Entscheidungsweg, Kriterien und Beteiligte offenlegen Jedes Gespräch mit bestätigtem Ergebnis und verbindlichen nächsten Schritten beenden Abschluss steuern Angebote strukturieren, Optionen klar darstellen, Einwände und Risiken offen adressieren Verbindliche Entscheidungsfahrpläne mit Kunden vereinbaren, wo nötig, führst du das Entscheidungsgespräch Einkauf, Laufzeiten, Leistungsumfang und Vertragspunkte verhandeln Beauftragung abschließen, Kick-off vereinbaren und die Übergabe an die Umsetzung sicherstellen Vom Einstieg zum Mandat Du schließt unsere Einstiegsprodukte ab, z. B. ISO 27001-Bestandsaufnahme, NIS2-Startpaket oder CRA-Startpaket Daraus entwickelst du Folgeaufträge über Mandate und Services, z. B. ISO 27001-Einführung oder NIS2-Umsetzung mit ISB-Mandat, Kryptoinventar- & SBOM-as-a-Service Fachliche Rückendeckung Bei der Lösungsarchitektur sitzt die Fachseite mit am Tisch. Du musst Technik nicht allein verkaufen Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung, ohne Freigabeweg über mehrere Ebenen Woran du gemessen wirst Abschlussquote, Angebotsdurchlaufzeit, Auftragseingang und Genauigkeit deiner Prognose. Nicht an der Zahl deiner Anrufe. So sieht deine Woche aus Unser Zielbild bei aufgebauter Pipeline: bis zu 10 vorqualifizierte Strategiegespräche pro Woche Ein fester Wochentermin mit der Geschäftsführung zu Pipeline und Risiken Abstimmung mit der Fachseite vor Gesprächen mit Lösungsbezug Monatsreview zu den Vertriebskennzahlen Das bringst du mit Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, davon mindestens 2 Jahre mit voller Abschlussverantwortung Erfahrung mit Mittelstand und Entscheidern auf Ebene Geschäftsführung und IT-Leitung Vertrautheit mit Informationssicherheit und relevanten gesetzlichen Anforderungen, insbesondere NIS2: Vertraulichkeit, Integrität und Verfügbarkeit sowie deren Bedeutung für Unternehmen kannst du sicher erklären. In produktspezifische Details arbeitest du dich mit Unterstützung unserer Fachseite ein – du musst kein Techniker sein. Sicherheit im Umgang mit Business Case, Einkauf und mehrstufigen Entscheidungen Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Haltung, lieber ehrlich abzusagen als schlecht zu verkaufen Was du wissen solltest Wir sind eine kleine Crew. Du bist die erste Besetzung im Abschluss, ein Vertriebsteam gibt es nicht. Du startest aber nicht bei null: Marke, Produkte, Website, Leadgenerierung, CRM und Angebotsvorlagen stehen bereits. Auf dieser Basis bauen wir die Pipeline weiter aus. Ein durchgehend gefüllter Kalender ist zum Start noch nicht zu erwarten. Wir setzen auf ein verlässliches Fixgehalt statt individueller Verkaufsprovisionen. Über eine crewweite Gewinnbeteiligung beteiligen wir dich am gemeinsamen Unternehmenserfolg. Du passt zu uns, wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen und unseren Vertrieb auf einer bestehenden Grundlage weiterentwickeln möchtest. Was wir bieten Crewweite Gewinnbeteiligung am gemeinsamen Unternehmenserfolg Unbefristeter Vertrag ab dem ersten Tag, mit drei Monaten Probezeit 30 Tage Urlaub , darüber hinaus nach Abstimmung Remote-first mit Büro in Karlsruhe als bezahlte Co-Working-Option Vertrauensarbeitszeit mit Zeiterfassung Persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget von 5 % des Bruttogehalts Mentoring und Patenschaft im Onboarding Moderne Ausstattung , für alle gleich Workcation in Blöcken bis zu vier Wochen, plus Crew-Days Weitere Optionen im persönlichen Gespräch Klingt nach deiner Mission? Dann melde dich bei Samuel Plewe , +49 721 181290-90 oder direkt über join.com. Wir antworten in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen und lesen jede Bewerbung selbst. Werde Teil der Crew, die schützt, was morgen zählt. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Factory: Static Analysis
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h3> <p>As a Staff Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Scanning team, you help developers find and fix security issues. Those issues live in the code they write, and you set the technical direction for the static analysis engine that finds them.</p> <p>Your work spans two complementary parts of a complete security analysis. On the engine side, you shape how the static analysis toolkit models a program: parsing source into intermediate representations, resolving symbols, building call graphs, and tracking tainted data across files and languages. You define the architecture and specifications the team builds against, and you delegate component specifications within them to engineers and to the AI agents that implement them. On the evaluation side, you build and apply tooling that tests, measures, and validates what the engine finds against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities.</p> <p>What the engine can model and how we measure what it finds are parts of one picture. As a Staff engineer you hold that picture, shape the long-range technical goals of the team, and raise the bar for every engineer on it. We build the engine with AI agents that write and review code from written specifications, under human direction. We expect you to direct that work effectively and with good judgment, and to help the team do the same.</p> <h3><strong>What you do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the directly responsible individual (DRI) for the team's highest-scope initiatives from design through delivery, shipping large features with minimal guidance and shaping the long-range goals of the team</li> <li>Bring systems built by one engineer to team ownership through documentation, tests, and shared review</li> <li>Set the technical direction for the AI-assisted tooling that implements, reviews, and validates engine changes and findings, design the checks that decide whether an agent-written change or generated result is fit to merge, and measure detection quality against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, raising the bar for what counts as a trustworthy result. That includes static application security testing (SAST) rules mapped to CWE and OWASP, and the test fixtures that prove they work.</li> <li>Own the architecture of the program model (parsing, symbol resolution, intermediate representations, call graphs, and taint and data-flow analysis) and of the pipeline that turns source code into findings, and define how both extend to new languages and frameworks</li> <li>Solve technical problems of the highest scope and complexity, actively seek out difficult impediments affecting the whole team, and advocate for improvements to quality, security, and performance with Product Management, UX, and partner teams such as Code Security and Composition Analysis</li> <li>Mentor all engineers on the team through code review and pairing, remove blockers to their autonomy, and shepherd the definition and improvement of our internal standards through review</li> <li>Participate in on-call rotations to assist troubleshooting product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues</li> <li>Define the overarching architecture and specification documents for the engine, delegate component specifications within them, and drive their implementation by AI agents and engineers working independently through phased plans, small reviewable units of change, and specifications kept in lockstep with the code</li> <li>Build and maintain the harness, agent instructions, and agentic skills that keep agent-written code trustworthy, including separate coding and reviewing agents, rules and tests the coding agents cannot change, independent review panels of agents from different model providers, and performance, API, and dependency gates, with risky changes escalated to human review</li> <li>Stay current with research in program analysis and security, run AI-assisted research and spikes, and turn the findings into prototypes, proposals, and upstream contributions, including responsible disclosure of findings in open source projects</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience building your own LLM tooling, such as a harness, an agent pipeline, or evaluations, with the judgment to know when output is trustworthy and when it isn't</li> <li>Extensive professional experience writing, testing, and reviewing production code in Rust, Go, or a comparable systems language, with depth in at least one. The engine is Rust, the analyzer wrapper is Go, and the monolith integration is Ruby, and we value willingness to work across them.</li> <li>Experience with performance optimization and with containerized workflows and CI/CD (we use Docker heavily)</li> <li>A deep program analysis and static analysis background, such as parsing and ASTs, intermediate representations (SSA, control-flow and call graphs), taint and data-flow analysis, type inference, incremental and fixpoint computation, or writing detection rules, with the ability to read, evaluate, and apply the research literature</li> <li>Deep application security experience, such as vulnerability research, secure code review, or writing detection rules, and fluency with vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10, CWE)</li> <li>Demonstrated capacity to communicate clearly and concisely about complex technical, architectural, and organizational problems, and to write architecture and design specifications that bring a team to a decision</li> <li>A track record of taking ownership of ambiguous, team-wide problems and shipping them from concept to production with minimal guidance, with specific, regular async updates on progress, blockers, risks, and next steps</li> <li>Experience defining a system's overarching architecture, delegating component specifications to engineers and AI agents, and getting them implemented reliably</li> <li>A track record of mentoring engineers, raising a team's technical bar, and influencing technical direction by achieving consensus with peers and leadership</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Helpful experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Familiarity with popular web or mobile application frameworks and how they handle input, data, and configuration</li> <li>Experience designing guardrails for agent-written code, such as mutation testing, fuzzing, and CI gates the coding agent cannot modify</li> <li>A record of engaging with the research community, such as publications, tool papers, or upstream open source contributions in program analysis or security</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Security Factory: Code Scanning team develops GitLab's SAST capabilities for customer software repositories.</p> <p>We work closely with the Code Security team on scanning rules & flows, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec Section. We rely heavily on asynchronous work across time zones.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Social Media & Content Manager (m/w/d), Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 20h, 100% Remote
description: Du kommst aus NRW und hast Bock mit Social Media organische Reichweite aufzubauen, die direkten Einfluss auf unsere Performance hat? Du willst Kanäle nicht verwalten, sondern selbst bespielen, von der Idee bis zum fertigen Reel? Dann lies weiter. Damit wir uns nicht missverstehen: Wir suchen keine reine Redaktionsplan-Verwaltung, die Content einplant, den jemand anderes produziert. Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Kanäle in die Hand nimmt. Du suchst die Creatorinnen, du schreibst, was gedreht werden soll, du schneidest, du postest, du antwortest und du sprichst unsere Ads ein. Und du zeigst dich selbst: in unseren Stories, vor der Kamera, mit deiner Stimme. Wenn du lieber im Hintergrund bleibst, passt es nicht. Bei uns liegt Organic komplett bei dir. Aufgaben Du verantwortest unsere organische Präsenz, von der Idee bis zum fertigen Post. Sivara ist eine Damen-Unterwäsche- und Umstandsmode-Brand mit über 120.000 Kundinnen, unsere Community redet viel mit uns, und genau da entsteht dein Content. Du bespielst Instagram und TikTok mit Reels, Stories und Posts, sodass wir präsent sind. Du produzierst und schneidest selbst: aus Creator-Material und eigenen Aufnahmen baust du Videos, die unser Produkt richtig in Szene setzen. Du betreust unsere Community auf Instagram und Facebook, beantwortest Kommentare und Nachrichten und erkennst dabei, welche Fragen immer wieder kommen. Aus genau diesen Fragen machst du dann Stories und Reels, die sie beantworten. Du findest neue UGC-Creatorinnen, die zu uns passen, verhandelst Barter-Deals und arbeitest mit Plattformen wie Trybe, etc. Du schreibst die Shootinglisten für unsere Creatorinnen, sammelst das Material ein und sortierst es so, dass wir damit arbeiten können. Du stehst selbst vor der Kamera: eine Story aus deinem Alltag, ein spontanes Video aus dem Lager, eine Ansage an die Community. Und du wirkst bei unseren Ad-Creatives mit, wenn wir dich brauchen. Du sprichst die Voice-Over für unsere Ads ein. Du betreust unsere Affiliate- und Deal-Partner, findest neue Partner und baust den Kanal mit aus. Du entwickelst, wie unsere Kanäle klingen und aussehen, schaust dir an was funktioniert hat und was nicht, und planst den nächsten Monat danach. Qualifikation Erfahrung im Social Media Marketing oder in der Content-Produktion, idealerweise für eine Brand oder im E-Commerce. Du schneidest selbst und sicher, mit CapCut, Premiere oder einem vergleichbaren Tool. Du hast eine angenehme, natürliche Sprechstimme und Lust darauf, regelmäßig Voice-Over einzusprechen. Du bist extrovertiert und stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera. In die Kamera sprechen, ins Mikro sprechen, dich in unseren Stories mit deinem Gesicht zeigen, ist für dich kein Problem. Du erkennst Formate und Trends früh und probierst sie aus, statt darauf zu warten, dass jemand sie freigibt. Du triffst im Community Management den richtigen Ton, freundlich und auf Augenhöhe, auch wenn eine Kundin genervt schreibt. Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau, weil alles was du schreibst direkt bei unseren Kundinnen landet. Du organisierst dich im Remote-Setup selbst und ziehst Themen durch, auch wenn niemand zuschaut. Nice-to-have: erste Berührung mit Affiliate- oder Deal-Plattformen, Erfahrung im Verhandeln mit Creatorinnen und deren Managements. Benefits 100% Remote, du arbeitest, wo du willst. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich deinem Leben anpassen. Wir bewerten dich nach Leistung, nicht nach Anwesenheit. Arzttermine, Workation und Ähnliches sind bei uns unkompliziert möglich, kurze Absprache reicht. Flache Hierarchien. Performance-Bonus für echte Ergebnisse. Netzwerk: Sivara ist eng vernetzt mit den führenden D2C-Brands Deutschlands und tauscht sich täglich mit anderen E-Commerce-Brands im 8- bis 9-stelligen Bereich aus. Du bekommst Einblicke und Kontakte, die du dir sonst über Jahre aufbauen müsstest. Bis hier durch? Dann sind wir vielleicht dein Match. Schick mir gerne ein kurzes, ungezwungenes Anschreiben per du. Dabei bist du nicht einfach „nur" Verkäufer:in, sondern Gesprächspartner:in und Berater:in auf Augenhöhe. Wenn du lieber Chancen schaffst, als auf Anfragen zu warten, freuen wir uns dich kennen zu lernen! Das gibt es zu tun Als Netzwerker:in im strategischen Neukundengeschäft: Du gewinnst strategisch relevante Neukund:innen über dein persönliches Netzwerk, Empfehlungen, Veranstaltungen und gezielte Direktansprache von Entscheider:innen Qualifizierte Termine aus unserem Sales Development übernimmst du, vertiefst die Bedarfsanalyse und entwickelst daraus konkrete Opportunities Gemeinsam mit unserem SDR definierst du Zielgruppen und Wunschkunden und sorgst für eine reibungslose Übergabe vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Abschluss Als Berater:in und Closer:in: Du berätst zu digitalen Lösungen – vom Website-Relaunch über individuelle Softwareprojekte bis hin zu KI-Produkten – und übersetzt technische Zusammenhänge in greifbaren Business-Nutzen Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Fachteams Lösungskonzepte, Kalkulationen und Angebote Du präsentierst Angebote, führst Verhandlungen und bringst Projekte eigenverantwortlich zum Abschluss Du baust nachhaltige Beziehungen zu unseren Kund:innen auf. Und im Tagesgeschäft: Du entwickelst unsere Bestandskund:innen aktiv weiter und identifizierst Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale Du beobachtest Markttrends, insbesondere im KI-Bereich, und leitest aktiv Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Sales-Strategie ab. Du steuerst deine Aktivitäten zielorientiert entlang klarer Vertriebs-KPIs – von Kontakten über Termine und Opportunities bis zum Auftragseingang Du pflegst Kontakte, Aktivitäten und Opportunities konsequent in unserem CRM und weißt jederzeit, welche nächsten Schritte anstehen Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Consulting und unseren Produktionsteams zusammen und bringst Impulse aus dem Markt direkt ins Team Das bringst Du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger digitaler Dienstleistungen oder Lösungen – idealerweise im Agenturumfeld – und nachweisbare Vertriebserfolge. Erfahrung darin, den gesamten Vertriebsprozess selbstständig zu führen: vom Erstkontakt über Beratung und Angebot bis zur Verhandlung und zum Abschluss. „Hunter-Mentalität“: Du gehst gerne aktiv auf Menschen zu und brauchst keine fertigen Leads, um erfolgreich zu sein. Fundiertes Verständnis in mehreren dieser Themen: Websites, Relaunches und CMS/DXP, UX/UI, digitales Marketing, Webentwicklung und Webtechnologien oder Individuelle Software-Entwicklung sowie Apps, APIs und Systemintegrationen – zusätzliches Know-how rund um KI, Chatbots und KI-Agenten ist ein Plus. Du musst kein:e Entwickler:in sein - aber du sprichst mit Entwickler:innen auf Augenhöhe und kannst gleichzeitig einer Geschäftsführung erklären, welchen Nutzen eine Lösung bringt. Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und Routine im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen - Zuverlässigkeit ist dabei einer deiner wichtigsten Werte. Idealerweise setzt du KI-Tools bereits aktiv im Vertriebsalltag ein, z. B. für Recherche, Gesprächsvorbereitung oder Angebotserstellung. Überzeugungskraft, Verbindlichkeit und den Willen, Ergebnisse zu verantworten: Du wartest nicht auf Chancen, du erzeugst sie. Gültige Fahrerlaubnis (Führerschein Klasse B) und Reisebereitschaft Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie eine klare, professionelle und sympathische Ausdrucksweise Das bekommst Du Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest. Remote Work: Homeoffice innerhalb von Deutschland oder Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro in Offenburg? Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten passt. AI-first arbeiten, statt darüber zu reden: Lizenzen für Vusyon, Claude, Chat-GPT, Copilot & Co. stellen wir. Neue Tools und Modelle darfst du ausprobieren - und deine Erkenntnisse verändern, wie das ganze Team arbeitet. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss - deutlich über dem gesetzlichen Standard. Du entscheidest ob Hanse fit-Mitgliedschaft oder 50 € monatlich per Spendit Card - dein Benefit, deine Wahl. Urlaub, der mit dir wächst: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub + dazu Weihnachten und Silvester frei - und mit steigender Betriebszugehörigkeit kommen weitere Tage dazu. Jobticket oder JobRad - wir machen deinen Weg ins Office einfacher und grüner. Feiern gehört dazu - Quarterly Allhands Events, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder einfach so - wir wissen, wie man Korken knallen lässt. Ein Team, das wirklich zählt. Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und ein offenes Ohr auch für das, was dich persönlich bewegt. Wir glauben daran, dass nachhaltiger Erfolg auf Augenhöhe entsteht; im echten Dialog mit unseren Kunden. Unsere 60 Kolleg:innen lassen diese Vision jeden Tag zur Realität werden. title: Health claims lead (f/m/x)
description: Intro As our Health Claims lead, you'll own claims decisions on Feather's health MGA books from day one: coverage, declines, settlement amounts, all within policy terms. You'll manage our insurance carrier relationships, decide how we work with service providers, and build the playbook, automations and systems that let the function scale as we grow MGA health claims fast across expat and international health. At Feather, we're building insurance that actually matters to our customers. It rests on three principles: a fully digital experience, modern and flexible plans, and reliable human support. And because we build it all for expats living abroad, we're a genuinely different kind of insurer. Why work at Feather? We're small, lean, and we love what we do. The usual buzzwords here, except we actually mean them. Staying small helps us focus on what matters, and we want to keep it that way. You'll work on a product that is loved by customers. Our excellent Trustpilot and Google reviews speak for themselves. There's plenty of space to grow. We trust you to take ownership and make real decisions from day one, and you'll have all the support you need to succeed. You'll have the freedom to build something from scratch. You're not inheriting a finished system. You're building the decision logic, reporting, and playbook that let health claims scale. Flexible remote work policy. We offer a remote-first work environment, hiring across Europe via an Employer of Record . We host company retreats, team dinners, and meetups to spend in-person time together. What you bring to the table You have hands-on experience handling health claims across borders or internationally. You are familiar with medical coding and provider billing. You have an instinct for automation and AI tooling, and you use it daily. You take tough decisions daily, including saying no to customers, and you still enjoy the work. You are pragmatic in an unfinished system: you improve it while running it. You are a fluent English speaker. Nice to have: German, Spanish, or French language skills. Experience with moratorium underwriting. A medical background. Experience in an MGA or delegated authority setup. Experience managing third-party administrators (TPAs). You'll be responsible for You will make claims decisions You will interpret coverage, decide declines, settlement amounts, and goodwill within policy terms, with real authority, not recommend-and-wait. You will handle expat and international health claims: cross-border invoices across languages and billing conventions, currency and tax, and coordination with statutory and private cover in the country of residence. You will manage our carrier relationships You will own claims reporting and bordereaux, contentious cases, and coverage disputes with our insurance partners. You will keep audit-ready records throughout, so nothing surprises the carrier. You will decide how we work with service providers You will decide where using third-party administrators (TPAs) makes sense, and manage instructions, quality, turnaround, and commercial performance where we use them. You will build the operating model You will close gaps with product and engineering across intake, documents, decision support, payout, and automation. You will run audits and fraud checks, working toward semi-automated monitoring with the data team. You will build capability You will write the playbook so health claims stops depending on one person. You will train whoever joins the team next. What will the interview process look like? CV screening Initial phone call with our People team. We'll have a chat and get to know each other (30m) Hiring manager call. We'll cover the role, skills needed, and answer your questions (1 hour) Case study. We'll give you a case study to work on, which will give you an idea of the type of projects you'd take on at Feather (3-4h) Case study discussion. We'll go through your reasoning and approach together (90min) Call with our Head of Ops. We'll talk through our async, remote-first way of working and how our team operates day to day (45min) Final interview. You'll be speaking to one member of our leadership team (45min) Does this sound like a good fit for you? Apply now! At Feather, we actively foster inclusive representation within our teams and embrace a diverse mix of talent. We encourage applicants from all educational paths to apply: we believe that what you’ve built, worked on, and achieved is far more important than on-paper qualifications. title: Lead Credit Ops
description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Role context Pennylane currently serves around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model and distributes short-term financing to a subset of those customers through specialised financing partners. As Financial Services becomes a larger part of Pennylane's strategy, we are applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences. Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers under our own licensed entity by early 2027 and to scale our own financing activity. We will outsource part of the technology stack—including the origination platform, disbursement and repayment orchestration, and the collections engine. Your focus will be on applying the credit policy, running controls and turning that policy into day-to-day operations, in close collaboration with our Product and Business teams. As Credit Operations Lead , you will build and launch the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s own-book financing activity. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will translate Risk’s credit policy into executable decisions, controlled workflows and auditable outcomes. You will initially remain hands-on across origination, manual reviews, exception handling and portfolio monitoring. As volumes grow, you will scale the operating model, tooling and team in close collaboration with Risk, Product and our financing partner. This is a high-autonomy, greenfield role at the heart of Pennylane’s future licensed operations. Responsibilities Own the end-to-end execution of credit origination, including manual reviews, decisions within the delegated first-line mandate, exception handling and escalation to Risk. Ensure that outcomes meet agreed SLAs and are supported by a complete audit trail. Build the credit operating model, including procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, first-line controls, operational KPIs and escalation paths. Own first-line operational monitoring of the active book, including repayment incidents, early-warning signals and the follow-up actions required by the credit policy. Build the operational relationship with the financing partner, with clear responsibilities, service levels and escalation processes for servicing, disbursement and collection incidents. Provide Risk with structured feedback on policy effectiveness, operational impact and emerging portfolio signals. Risk remains accountable for risk appetite, policy approval and independent oversight. Partner with Product, Tech, Risk and Data to design origination workflows, analyst tools and scoring processes, translate operational needs into product requirements, and determine what to automate or retain for human review. Remain hands-on during the launch phase, then recruit and lead the first credit analysts as volumes grow, establishing clear quality standards and a culture of rigour, accountability and customer clarity. First 6–12 months Before the first own-book exposure, deliver an approved end-to-end operating model covering procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, evidence requirements and escalation paths to Risk. Ensure that the origination workflow is operationally ready for launch by testing the main decision paths and failure scenarios with Product and Tech. Establish the initial management framework, including SLAs, quality controls, operational KPIs, portfolio-monitoring indicators and reporting to the second-line Risk function. Ensure that every credit decision can be reconstructed from the underlying data, evidence, applicable policy and recorded approvals. Define the initial capacity model, team coverage and hiring plan based on expected volumes, handling times and observed performance. By go-live, have trained operational coverage, named escalation owners and documented procedures for manual reviews, exceptions and partner incidents. What we’re looking for Significant experience in credit or underwriting operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including manual reviews, delegated decisions, exceptions and audit trails. Experience managing operational quality, SLAs and capacity, with direct team leadership or a strong player-coach track record. Strong understanding of first-line credit operations and the respective responsibilities of Operations and Risk. Experience collaborating with Product or Tech teams on workflows, tooling and automation. Ability to use operational and portfolio indicators to identify early-warning signals, manage performance and plan capacity. Sound judgement on what to automate, what requires human review and when a case should be escalated. Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions and communicate them clearly to customers, partners and internal stakeholders. Experience with SME financing products, such as invoice financing or short-term working-capital facilities, would be a strong advantage. Languages, presence and location Fluent French and English are mandatory. Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris. Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role. Why join Build the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s future société de financement from the ground up. Shape the operating model, tooling and team before the own-book financing activity reaches scale. Take ownership of a critical function with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer experience and responsible growth. Work closely with Risk, Product, Tech and our financing partner on a strategic company project. Join a high-autonomy role with compensation that includes equity and reflects the level of responsibility. Recruitment Process 1. Interview with Simon (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter 2. title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Factory: Code Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Security team, you help developers find and fix security issues. Those issues live in the code they write and in the open source components they depend on.</p> <p>Your work spans complementary parts of a complete security analysis. On the dependency analysis side, you teach the analysis engine what a project depends on. You parse dependency manifests, lockfiles, and SBOMs so the engine knows which libraries and frameworks are in play and how the code uses them. You also extend the service that turns security advisories into automated merge requests that update vulnerable dependencies. On the vulnerability detection side, you grow GitLab's security analysis engine with hybrid analyzers that blend rule-based detection and AI reasoning. You build and apply the tooling that develops, evaluates, and ships those analyzers, and you measure how well they find real problems. That work also expands coverage of the libraries, frameworks, and AI agent tooling that real-world applications are built on.</p> <p>These threads reinforce each other. What a project depends on, and how its code uses those dependencies, are parts of one picture, and this team works across all of it. We make thoughtful use of AI-assisted development tools in our daily work. We expect you to use them effectively and with good judgment.</p> <h3><strong>What you do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the directly responsible individual (DRI) for team initiatives from design through delivery, shipping with minimal guidance in partnership with the technical lead</li> <li>Bring systems built by one engineer to team ownership through documentation, tests, and shared review</li> <li>Design and ship analyzers that pair deterministic analysis capabilities with AI-driven analysis, and build the evaluation harnesses that measure their false positives and missed findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, raising the bar for what counts as a trustworthy result. That includes detection rules mapped to CWE and the test fixtures that prove they work.</li> <li>Package those analyzers for every place GitLab runs them, including CI jobs, AI agent workflows, and command-line tools, with findings reported in GitLab's standard security report formats</li> <li>Design and ship the manifest, lockfile, and SBOM parsing that tells the static analysis engine what a project depends on, and extend it to new ecosystems and formats</li> <li>Ship features across the automated remediation service that turns security advisories into dependency update merge requests, from sandboxed updates to merge request creation</li> <li>Solve technical problems of high scope and complexity, actively seek out difficult impediments affecting the whole team, and advocate for improvements to quality, security, and performance with Product Management, Engineering stakeholders such as Frontend and UX, and partner teams such as Code Scanning and Composition Analysis</li> <li>Mentor Intermediate engineers through code review and pairing, and maintain our internal standards for style, maintainability, and best practices through review</li> <li>Participate in on-call rotations to assist troubleshooting product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience building your own LLM tooling, such as a harness, an agent pipeline, or evaluations, with the judgment to know when output is trustworthy and when it isn't</li> <li>Substantial professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Go and/or Rust, with depth in at least one. We use both, plus Ruby on the remediation side and Python for some analyzers, and value willingness to work across them.</li> <li>Familiarity with package managers and dependency management in one or more language ecosystems, such as npm, Maven, pip, Bundler, or Cargo. Experience building tooling around them is better still.</li> <li>Demonstrated application security experience, such as vulnerability research, secure code review, or writing detection rules, and fluency with vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10, CWE) and the software supply chain</li> <li>A track record of taking ownership of ambiguous problems and shipping with minimal guidance, with the self-motivation and organizational skills suited to a remote, largely asynchronous environment</li> <li>Demonstrated capacity to communicate clearly and concisely about technical problems, and to write design proposals that bring a team to a decision</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Helpful experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience evaluating AI-driven detection against labeled data, including measuring false positives and missed findings</li> <li>Experience with performance optimization at scale</li> <li>Hands-on program analysis experience, such as parsing, ASTs, or data-flow analysis</li> <li>Familiarity with popular web or mobile application frameworks and how they handle input, data, and configuration</li> <li>Experience with containerized workflows and CI/CD (we use Docker heavily)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Security Factory: Code Security team builds GitLab's code-level security scanning capabilities, spanning static application security testing and dependency scanning. We help developers find and fix security issues in both the code they write and the open source components they depend on, as early as possible.</p> <p>We work closely with the Static Analysis team on GitLab's SAST engines, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec Section. We rely heavily on asynchronous work across time zones.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Academic Dean for MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio
description: Location : 100% remote (Ohio residency required) Classification : Full-time, exempt Reports to : School Leader Pay Range : $40.00 - $48.00 per hour Welcome to Miaplaza! Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð Role Summary The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Instructional Staff Management Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting. Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers. Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback. Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback. Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals. Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences. Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations. Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed. Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes. Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law. Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together. Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns. Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track. Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas. Academic Data & Testing Coordination Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions. Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing. Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families. Professional Development Design and lead regular PD sessions for instructional staff, informed by teacher feedback, observation, and student data. Build a culture of continuous improvement, reflective practice, and growth for the instructional team. Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the worldâs most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But thatâs just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself. Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it. Mandatory: Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps. Strong product sense : you can tell a good feature from a busy one. Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints : model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away. You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities. Deep JavaScript and React . Initiative, curiosity, resilience , and the ability to give and receive direct critique. Preferred: Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source . title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Revenue Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll own work the whole go-to-market organization relies on: the policies and processes that govern how we sell and book deals, our global forecasting process, and the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) operating cadence. You'll report to the Senior Manager, Sales Operations, and work closely with sales leadership, other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams, Finance, Deal Desk, Product, and Data.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll bring experience running a forecast process day to day and a practical understanding of how a sales organization works. You'll work independently to take a problem from "something looks off in the numbers" to a fix that sticks.</p> <p>GitLab is all-remote, and most of our work happens in writing. Clear, concise documentation is a big part of this job.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the policies that define how deals are booked, credited, and forecasted, including bookings rules, opportunity netting, and sales stages and exit criteria. Write them, get them approved, and make sure the field understands what changed and why.</li> <li>Identify process problems before they affect the numbers. Validate and size the problem with data, find the root cause, and drive the fix with the right team, whether that's Revenue Systems, Deal Desk, Enablement, or compensation.</li> <li>Partner with Revenue Systems to build policy into system rules, validations, and alerts, reducing manual reviews and after-the-fact corrections.</li> <li>Improve forecast methodology by tracking actual results against the forecast, explaining variances, and changing processes that aren't working. Partner with Finance and Revenue Analytics to reconcile the field forecast with the finance outlook.</li> <li>Own the weekly forecast readout for the CRO and sales leadership, keeping it short and focused on decisions. Bring the forecasting and policy perspective into annual planning.</li> <li>Coordinate the CRO organization's weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews, metrics, and follow-ups. Measure their impact on pipeline hygiene, data quality, forecast accuracy, and bookings, and change the cadence where it isn't working.</li> <li>Work with other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams, Finance, Product, Data, and Enablement to deliver changes from the first draft through field adoption. Keep cadence documentation current so the organization knows what happens when, who owns it, and what's expected.</li> <li>Mentor others on the team and improve how we document and run our processes.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, management consulting, or a similar role, including running a forecast process day to day in a business-to-business (B2B) subscription business.</li> <li>A practical understanding of how a sales organization runs, including pipeline stages, deal bookings and crediting, bookings and annual recurring revenue (ARR) definitions, and how compensation influences sales representative behavior.</li> <li>Strong data and analysis skills. You're highly proficient in Excel or Google Sheets, can build a model from scratch, and check your own numbers before sharing them.</li> <li>The ability to work independently, identify what needs to be done, and work with stakeholders to get it done. You involve your manager when you need a decision or hit a blocker.</li> <li>Clear, concise writing. You can turn a complex issue into a short document or Slack message that a senior leader will read and act on.</li> <li>Comfort working with senior leaders, including taking feedback from a CRO and turning it into a better process or a more useful readout.</li> <li>Systems thinking and the ability to learn new tools and domains quickly. You understand how customer relationship management (CRM), quoting, billing, and compensation systems connect, and how a change in one affects the others. How you think matters more to us than which forecasting tool you've used.</li> <li>Helpful, but not required: experience rolling out bookings, crediting, or deal policies; forecasting consumption or usage-based revenue; using tools such as Clari and Salesforce reporting; or a consulting, strategy, or structured problem-solving background.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Sales Strategy & Operations team sits within Revenue Strategy & Operations at GitLab. We're a small team working closely with Finance, Deal Desk, Revenue Systems, Revenue Analytics, and sales leadership. We work asynchronously first, keep our documents short, and focus on practical solutions that make the field's job easier.</p> <h4><br><br><br></h4><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLBeneUS" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">benefits</a><span data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#000000;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Arial';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;"> and </span><a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLequity" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">equity</a>. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div class="title">United States Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$104,800</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$176,400 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Partner with People Technology Analysts on configuration, testing and releases, and with Information Security, IT and AI Engineering on security and standards.</li> <li>Raise the bar for how automations are architected, documented and maintained, learning from and contributing alongside our Lead People Systems Engineer.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience building automations or integrations, ideally with human resources or business systems.</li> <li>Experience writing and maintaining code in Ruby or a comparable scripting language, such as Python or JavaScript, and a willingness to learn Ruby if you haven’t already.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Workato or a comparable integration platform as a service (iPaaS) in a production environment.</li> <li>Experience working with APIs and web services, including REST and SOAP, and an understanding of how data moves between systems.</li> <li>Proficiency with Git for version control and code review; you treat automation code like production software.</li> <li>A forward-thinking, AI-forward mindset: you use AI tools every day to automate tasks, speed up development and improve processes, and you’re energized by what AI makes possible next.</li> <li>The ability to work independently, solve problems with curiosity, come with options and a recommendation, and collaborate openly. You protect highly confidential information and take ownership of code quality, reliable outcomes and the end user’s experience.</li> <li>Additional relevant experience includes Workday integrations (WWS, Reporting as a Service or Workday Studio), Slack apps or bots, CI/CD pipelines, Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services, Docker or Kubernetes, building with LLMs, AI agents or MCP frameworks, SOX ITGC controls, Greenhouse, Serval, Google Workspace, or all-remote and asynchronous work. A related computing degree or equivalent experience is also welcome; none of these is required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The People Technology team is building the systems foundation that lets GitLab scale as a global, all-remote company.
