title: Product Manager - Realtime
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. About the Role We're hiring a Product Manager for Supabase Realtime https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime. You'll own the surface area developers use to build live, collaborative and event-driven apps on Supabase: Broadcast https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/broadcast, Presence https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/presence, Postgres Changes https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/postgres-changes, and the capabilities we build next. You'll work closely with the Realtime Engineering team and with partners across Product Management, Design and GTM. This role is ideal for someone who's excited about building tools for millions of developers and who has a passion for the types of user experiences unlocked by simple, scalable real-time channels. You should have a nuanced understanding of full-stack application development, including existing and emerging real-time and sync patterns. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - You'll collaborate with customers of all sizes and expertise levels: from an indie developer adding live updates to a side project, to startups building collaborative SaaS, to enterprise teams streaming live data to dashboards. - You'll own the problem statements and solution rationale behind the Realtime roadmap. This means working with Engineering and Design to shape how Supabase crafts the developer experience for the problems you’ve prioritized solving. - You'll shape how Realtime evolves to enable future application experiences, including its role in AI apps and alongside other Supabase products. - You'll own Realtime packaging and pricing, working with Pricing, Finance and Billing. - You'll use data to understand how Supabase developers are using Realtime features: where they succeed, where they get stuck, and what to tackle first. - You'll keep Engineering, Design and GTM aligned. You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE - 5+ years of Product Management experience on developer tools, or are an ex-founder with equivalent depth. You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc, following a design discussion, and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required. - Have owned an app development platform, feature or framework where real-time was core to the developer experience. - Get your own answers from data. You know what you care about in terms of product instrumentation and are comfortable querying and cleaning your own findings. - Are comfortable with Postgres and familiar with logical replication. - Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings. STRONG SIGNAL - You have an existing audience among developers, through social media, open source or developer advocacy. - Worked on a sync engine, local-first or live-query product. - Worked with gaming, AR or collaborative-tool customers. - Shipped something using Supabase. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Recruiting Coordinator - AMER
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission. We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome. COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily non-technical roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly. BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 6–12 months of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment - Strong organizational and prioritization skills - you’re proactive, reliable, and thoughtful about details - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills - you’ll represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results NICE TO HAVES: - Experience supporting both technical and non-technical roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack - Experience in a high-growth or startup environment Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $95,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Engineer - Silicon Enablement
description: <p>Ubuntu Linux is already the most popular Linux distribution in the world, and its mission is to remain at the forefront of the global software ecosystem. As the industry evolves, we are expanding our support for a wider array of System on Chip (SoC) platforms to ensure that every user receives a high-performance and reliable experience. There is growing and vital demand from major silicon manufacturers such as NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, MediaTek, and Renesas to provide Ubuntu Linux as the foundational platform for their next-generation hardware.</p> <p>The Canonical Kernel Team is responsible for the build, maintenance, and distribution of the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. We are looking for engineers who share our passion for building high-quality, robust software foundations that others can rely upon. This role sits at a critical junction in the software stack, ensuring that the underlying hardware is seamlessly integrated, optimized and prepared to meet the demands of modern computing.</p> <p>While direct experience with the Linux kernel would be an advantage, it is not a hard requirement. Candidates with RTOS or bare-metal experience and demonstrable hardware experience are encouraged to apply.</p> <p>We welcome applications from engineers at various stages of their careers, from those beginning their journey in hardware-level development to seasoned industry veterans.</p> <h2><strong>Location</strong></h2> <p>This is a globally remote role.</p> <h2><strong>What the role entails</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Drive the integration of platform support from our silicon partners into the Ubuntu Linux kernel</li> <li>Lead the identification and resolution of complex kernel issues reported by partners, customers, or discovered through rigorous testing</li> <li>Own the delivery of distinct, silicon-optimized variants of the Ubuntu Linux kernel to the global community</li> <li>Develop and refine the tooling and automation required for the reliable delivery and testing of our kernels</li> <li>Manage the submission and review process for upstream patches, collaborating effectively with both internal and external maintainers</li> <li>Identify new methodologies and strategies for maximizing performance on partner silicon</li> <li>Collaborate proactively within a globally distributed engineering team to ensure cohesive outcomes across the organization</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proficiency in C programming, particularly for low-level system development</li> <li>A strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other aspects of hardware-level system engineering</li> <li>Deep understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals</li> <li>Professional proficiency with Git for version control and collaborative development</li> <li>Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal, within a professional context</li> <li>A professional approach to collaborating with business partners and the open-source community</li> <li>Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks in length</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with Python or Bash scripting for automation and tooling</li> <li>Prior experience working with major SoC families (e.g., NVIDIA, Intel, AMD, Qualcomm, MediaTek, Renesas)</li> <li>Familiarity with Ubuntu, Debian, or Snap packaging</li> <li>Demonstrated expertise in Linux kernel patching and debugging</li> <li>A deep understanding of performance optimization techniques for silicon platforms</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Home-based work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About Canonical</strong></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. </p> <p><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

title: Professional Services Technical Architect - West
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Professional Services Technical Architect at GitLab, you'll lead the technical direction of customer engagements from early scoping and discovery through delivery. You'll design high-level architectures and implementation plans for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, and you'll make sure deliverables align with customer requirements and the Statement of Work (SOW). You'll coordinate and guide implementation work across GitLab Professional Services and partner consultants, support customers deploying GitLab in cloud and on-premises environments using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit, and perform migrations to GitLab using Congregate. You'll provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best practices, contribute reusable collateral such as documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and share product release updates to help the team deliver consistent outcomes. This role combines deep technical expertise with customer-facing leadership in GitLab's remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Designing and delivering GitLab reference architecture implementations for both self-managed and cloud environments, using infrastructure as code practices</li> <li>Leading source code management and CI/CD migrations to GitLab, including large-scale enterprise moves using Congregate</li> <li>Building repeatable delivery kits, documentation, and enablement materials that help Professional Services and partners deploy and adopt GitLab best practices</li> <li>Lead the full technical delivery lifecycle for GitLab Professional Services engagements, from early scoping and technical discovery through implementation and handoff.</li> <li>Produce high-level and detailed technical designs for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, ensuring deliverables align with customer requirements and expectations.</li> <li>Evaluate and communicate scalability and security considerations (including compliance constraints) in proposed GitLab reference architectures and implementation plans.</li> <li>Deploy and configure GitLab in customer environments, including on-premises and major cloud providers, using Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit (GET) aligned to reference architectures.</li> <li>Plan and execute source system migrations to GitLab using Congregate, partnering closely with customer stakeholders to reduce risk, protect data integrity, and minimize downtime.</li> <li>Provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best-practice guidance, including advising on internal frameworks such as the Delivery Governance Framework (DGF) and GitLab Flow.</li> <li>Coordinate and oversee implementation work across GitLab team members, partners, and customer points of contact (POCs), ensuring clear asynchronous communication and decision capture, effective execution, and high-quality outcomes.</li> <li>Mentor Professional Services and partner consultants by contributing documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and by leading enablement sessions on how to deliver and position service offerings.</li> <li>Maintain and improve delivery automation assets with an emphasis on code cleanliness, maintainability, and appropriate unit/integration testing.</li> <li>Support scoping and Statement of Work (SOW) creation with Professional Services Engagement Managers, stay current on monthly GitLab releases, and help Regional Delivery Managers with technical vetting and staffing assessments while maintaining a 55% billable utilization.</li> <li>Review and provide input to Professional Services training materials and presentations</li> <li>Develop case studies, presentations, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies</li> <li>Work closely with customer project teams to ensure accurate task-level articulation of work required</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions with customers and partners and communicate risks/trade-offs clearly in an asynchronous environment.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Prefer location in PST, MST or CST timezone alignment. </strong><strong>Comfortable with up to 30% travel at times.</strong><strong>Demonstrated experience delivering two or more of the following consulting services: source code management migration, cloud architecture, DevOps engineering, or continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) consulting services.</strong><strong>Enterprise software development experience, with the ability to translate requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans.</strong><strong>Progressive DevOps platform experience, including designing and implementing reliable, scalable systems with clear performance and security trade-offs.</strong><strong>Hands-on experience deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud providers and on-premises environments, including using tools such as Terraform and Ansible.</strong><strong>Ability to write clean, maintainable automation/integration code (e.g., Terraform modules, Ansible roles, scripts) and validate changes with appropriate testing and code review.</strong><strong>Experience performing migrations to GitLab, including using Congregate or similar migration tooling.</strong><strong>Working knowledge of data consistency and integrity concepts (e.g., ACID properties) and how they impact migration design and performance trade-offs.</strong><strong>Strong problem-solving, decision-making, organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.</strong><strong>Comfort working in a remote, asynchronous environment, using documented decisions (e.g., issues, proposals, and runbooks) to keep work unblocked across time zones while collaborating effectively across GitLab team members, partners, and customer stakeholders.</strong><strong>Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or other advanced technical degree, or equivalent experience</strong></h4> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Professional Services Technical Architect is part of GitLab's Professional Services organization. We partner with customers who are transitioning to GitLab, expanding how they use an existing GitLab installation, or planning complex upgrades to their infrastructure and processes. Our team brings a diverse set of skills across GitLab deployment, maintenance, and day-to-day usage, along with deep technical knowledge of adjacent tools and platforms. Working closely with Engagement Managers, partner consultants, and customer stakeholders, we focus on delivering high-quality outcomes, sharing best practices, and helping customers realize faster time to value from their GitLab investment. We operate in GitLab's remote, asynchronous environment and rely on clear documentation and transparent communication to collaborate effectively.</p> <p>This role models skills and behavior aligned with GitLab Values and typically reports to the Regional Delivery Manager. As a Professional Services Technical Architect, you will work more independently than an associate consultant, leveraging deep technical expertise to drive customer outcomes.</p> <h4><br><br><br><br><br></h4><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. Measure and share what works, publish reusable patterns, and retire those that don't.</li> <li>Ship agents and multi-step workflows for account research, success planning, scoping, status reporting, and customer onboarding. Package them as skills and plugins for non-engineers using Claude, Claude in Slack, and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.</li> <li>Build MCP servers and connectors for governed access to GitLab, Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, Thought Industries, Gong, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems. Add evaluations, tracing, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints to keep internal and customer-facing agents measurable, auditable, and safe with customer data.</li> <li>Evolve the CX Application Platform's gateway, Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, including Elastic Container Service (ECS), Relational Database Service (RDS), and Lambda, Terraform configuration, application scaffold, and deployment path. Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.</li> <li>Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.</li> <li>Prototype with Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training in days, not quarters. Help CX team members bring their own applications to production, and turn field learning into reusable reference implementations, development paths, and enablement.</li> <li>Contribute upstream to GitLab and share product feedback with Product and Engineering. Mentor engineers and non-engineers on agentic development and raise the team's code review bar.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building and operating production software, owning multi-quarter work from ambiguity to production, choosing reusable platform solutions over one-off customization where appropriate, and designing for handoff.</li> <li>Daily, hands-on use of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitLab Duo, or similar on production work. You can show how they've changed what you ship and how you maintain quality.</li> <li>Experience building with large language models (LLMs) beyond chat, including tool use, MCP servers, agent loops, context and retrieval design, prompt and workflow design, and evaluations.</li> <li>Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Flask and TypeScript skills with Vue or React, including application programming interface (API) design, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer and business data.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta.</li> <li>Experience integrating enterprise systems through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL APIs, and fluency with Git, merge requests, and CI/CD.</li> <li>Experience translating non-engineering stakeholders' workflows into technical plans and writing clear asynchronous design documents, decision records, and enablement materials. You align with GitLab's values and are willing to use GitLab for your own work.</li> <li>Optional experience includes agent harness customization; the GitLab Development Kit, Duo Agent Platform custom agents and flows, or AI Catalog publishing; enterprise agent governance and data controls; customer success, professional services, or learning platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, or Thought Industries; professional services economics and customer success metrics; Snowflake or similar warehouses; and technical writing, talks, or open source contributions on agentic development.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; you don't need to meet every nice-to-have to apply.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>CX Platform Engineering builds and runs CX Applications for Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training. We own the CX Application Platform's gateway and infrastructure alongside our application portfolio: GitLab University, the Foundational Onboarding Agent in GitLab Duo Agent Platform, Congregate, PS Compass, and Customer Wins. We build the first version with the people doing the work, turn what we learn into a reusable pattern, then hand it off so it runs without us. We reward leverage, not heroics, and don't leave tools dependent on one person.</p> <h4><br><br></h4><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. If you are excited about co-creating the future as we're building the most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform, we want to hear from you. </strong></p> <h2>Location: San Francisco </h2> <h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Strategic Account Executive on our AMER Enterprise team, you'll help large, regulated organizations adopt, implement, and expand their use of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. results and long-term expansion.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Support GitLab’s strategic large prospects and customers as a trusted advisor throughout their DevSecOps journey.</li> managers, marketing, and technical teams.</li> <li value="8">Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas, and use a consultative approach to create proposals, quotes, and presentations that clearly link GitLab’s solutions to customer business objectives.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">A true desire to see customers achieve meaningful outcomes GitLab in your daily work, and are able to travel if needed while following GitLab’s travel policy.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Enterprise Sales team is responsible for driving growth, paths.</li> <li>Create and improve upon the processes, metrics and KPIs for SME-led technical evaluations, workshops, demos and Proofs of Value.</li> <li>Partner with CRO staff, regional sales leaders and AVPs on product-category performance, forecast risk and competitive strategy.</li> <li>Partner with Enablement to drive  field readiness for new product launches with Product Marketing and Enablement, including Duo Agent Platform, security and platform offerings.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with key customers at the technical sponsor and executive level.</li> <li>Use AI to change how the team works, including deal research, demo creation, PoV automation and knowledge sharing.</li> <li>Drive organizational transformation by finding gaps early, building structure where none exists, and leading change without waiting for top-down direction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years second-line leadership experience (managing managers) in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering or a technical specialist organization.</li> <li>Experience building or scaling a specialist, overlay or global SA team in enterprise SaaS, DevSecOps, security or developer tools.</li> <li>A record of tying technical-team design to bookings and consumption outcomes, with the data to show it.</li> <li>The ability to lead through ambiguity and rapid organizational change, bringing clarity and direction while strategy is still forming.</li> <li>Strong relationships with Product and Engineering leaders, and a history of shaping roadmap from field insight.</li> <li>Fluency across the software development lifecycle, application security (SAST, DAST, SCA), cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes and AI-assisted development, including LLM evaluation and production deployment patterns.</li> <li>Executive presence with technical practitioners, managers and C-level stakeholders.</li> <li>Proven ability to partner across Sales, Partners, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success and Professional Services.</li> <li>A self-starting, entrepreneurial approach. You don't wait for a playbook; you write it.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>How you'll be measured</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Global product-category commit attainment and consumption growth.</li> <li>Time from technical win to first workload in customer’s production environment on SME-engaged opportunities compared with non-engaged opportunities.</li> <li>SME coverage and engagement speed on the top 10% of opportunities.</li> <li>Account Team capability lift: fewer escalations and more deals handled without an SME over time.</li> <li>Product impact: field sentiment on the product feedback process along with field-sourced requirements adopted into the roadmap.</li> <li>Team health: hiring against plan, manager development, engagement and retention.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Subject Matter Expertise (SME) organization is part of GitLab's Solutions Architecture team, a trusted technical partner for the field. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>This position is 100% remote and will be based in the United States and Canada.</p> <p>The Pipeline Programs Manager turns GitLab's pipeline targets into programs the field can run. You'll own execution of pipeline generation programs, including sales plays, PipeGen days, and run the hygiene checkpoints that keep pipeline data trustworthy. You'll also help surface the risks and upside behind our pipeline plan working across Sales, Marketing, Field Enablement, Sales Strategy, and RevOps. </p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Execute global and regional pipeline generation programs, including codified sales plays and PipeGen days, against an established program calendar.</li> <li>Coordinate in-quarter program delivery across regions and segments: timelines, owners, communications, and follow-through on action items.</li> <li>Run weekly, monthly, and quarterly pipeline hygiene checkpoints, and report on adherence and trends with RevOps and Sales Strategy.</li> <li>Partner with Marketing and Enablement to bring pipeline generation programs to the field with the right messaging, content, and training.</li> <li>Work with the team on the GTM plan by identifying the drivers, risks, and upside that could move the pipeline numbers, and making them visible to decision-makers.</li> <li>Give input on the design of sales plays, hygiene standards, and related incentives from what you see during execution.</li> <li>Track program performance against success measures, and summarize what worked, what didn't, and what to change next time.</li> <li>Coordinate global outbound program execution with Sales Development and sales leaders, and help bring it to regional and team levels at scale.</li> <li>Identify process and systems improvements in Salesforce and reporting that increase metric visibility and reduce manual work, and work with RevOps and Systems to land them.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ Years experience in Sales, Sales Programs, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Field or Sales Enablement, or Marketing Operations, with a record of delivering programs on time and with quality.</li> <li>Experience running cross-functional programs with operational rigor: multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and clear follow-through.</li> <li>Comfort working with pipeline data. You can use Salesforce and BI dashboards to spot gaps and explain what they mean. Basic SQL (Snowflake or similar) is a plus.</li> <li>Understanding of the B2B sales funnel: pipeline creation, conversion, velocity, and hygiene.</li> <li>Clear communication and presentation skills. You can explain a program or a risk to Sales leaders and to cross-functional partners.</li> <li>Ability to influence without authority, earning trust and moving work forward across teams you don't manage.</li> <li>Good judgment in a fast-moving environment. You move quickly, keep quality high, and know when to escalate.</li> <li>Curiosity about how AI and automation can improve go-to-market execution.</li> <li>Ownership mindset. You carry programs through to outcomes, not just activity.</li> <li>Experience in a quota-carrying or sales role is a plus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>The Pipeline Excellence team builds the pipeline engine that turns GitLab's growth targets into predictable, repeatable revenue outcomes. We set pipeline targets and the GTM plan, run the programs and cadence that keep the field moving, and turn pipeline data into recommendations on where to invest.</p> <p>We work with Speed with Quality, so our cadence and standards let go-to-market teams move fast without sacrificing forecast accuracy. We hold an Ownership Mindset, meaning every stage of the funnel has a defined owner and standard. We measure ourselves on Customer Outcomes: pipeline health exists to drive real bookings and real customer relationships, not just activity. title: Senior Backend Developer (Go) — Full Remote, European Timezones Only (UTC−1 to UTC+3)
description: Read this first — two non-negotiables Go is the job, not a bonus skill. We're only considering candidates with 5+ years of hands-on, production experience in Go . If Go isn't (one of) your primary languages, this role won't be a match — and we'd rather save you the time. You must live in a European timezone (UTC−1 to UTC+3). This is a hard requirement. Applications from outside this range won't be considered, regardless of how strong the profile is. Still with us? Great — here's why this role is worth your attention. Who we are We're Jobtome ( https://weare.jobtome.com/ ) — an HR Tech company building the modern web applications that companies use to run complex hiring and recruitment workflows at scale. Our products are highly interactive, data-driven, and built for real-world usage — not demos. We work with a strong product mindset, short feedback loops, and a pragmatic engineering culture: quality, ownership, and code we're still proud of a year from now. The role You'll join our engineering team as a Senior Go Backend Developer and take real ownership of critical backend systems and services — not ticket-pushing, actual ownership. You'll design, build, and evolve the backend services that power our products, weigh in on architectural decisions, improve system reliability, and help shape how backend engineering is done across the company. This is a hands-on senior role: you'll write production Go every day and be deeply involved in technical decisions that have real impact. Quick reminder before the details 5+ years of production Go experience — required Based in a European timezone (UTC−1 to UTC+3) What you'll do Design, build, and maintain backend services written in Go Build and evolve APIs (GraphQL and/or REST) behind complex product workflows Design scalable, reliable, and maintainable backend architectures Work closely with frontend engineers, product managers, data engineers, and designers Contribute to data modeling, business logic, and performance optimization Review code and take part in architectural and technical discussions Raise the bar on code quality, testing, observability, and system resilience Actively tackle refactoring, technical debt, and long-term improvements Own backend features end to end, from design to production Take part in Agile ceremonies (planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) Our stack Go sits at the center of everything. Around it, you'll work with (and should be comfortable with): API design (GraphQL and/or REST) PostgreSQL (or similar relational databases) BigQuery and other NoSQL databases Distributed systems and service-oriented architectures Docker and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab pipelines preferred) A cloud-infrastructure mindset (GCP or other providers) Observability tools (logging, metrics, tracing) Testing (unit and/or integration) Kubernetes Nice to have: Working experience with Python Exposure to Protobuf and gRPC What "senior" means to us Titles vary — here's what we actually mean. A senior engineer at Jobtome can: Work independently without needing perfect specs Own complex features and systems Make informed architectural decisions and explain the trade-offs Write clean, maintainable, well-structured code Spot problems early and propose solutions Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical people alike Raise the team's quality bar through example and reviews How we work Full remote — from anywhere within UTC−1 to UTC+3 (yes, we're repeating it on purpose) Core hours, with flexibility around them Daily working language: English Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>Aa Senior Account Executive, you’ll be the primary connection between GitLab and our Commercial & Enterprise customers, working with organizations of up to 4,000 team members to help them adopt and expand the world’s most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll own a broad book of business across a wide range of opportunity sizes, guiding small, fast-growing teams as well as more complex projects as they modernize their software delivery with GitLab. Reporting to an Area Sales Manager and partnering closely with business development, marketing, and technical teams, you’ll run the full sales process: shaping the customer’s journey, documenting buying criteria and processes, ensuring accurate pipeline based on evidence, and sharing root-cause insights on wins and losses. In your first year, you’ll focus on building trusted relationships, delivering meaningful business outcomes for customers, and being the voice of the customer internally by contributing ideas to our public issue tracker and improving our sales handbook.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Report to an Regional Sales Director and own a broad book of Commercial & Enterprise business, from new prospects to growing existing accounts.</li> <li value="2">Manage the full sales cycle for Commercial & Enterprise prospects, from discovery and solution alignment through negotiation and close.</li> <li value="3">Support GitLab for Commercial & Enterprise prospects by clearly articulating our DevSecOps value proposition and aligning it to customer business outcomes.</li> <li value="4">Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analyses, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams.</li> <li value="5">Document and maintain accurate buying criteria, buying processes, next steps, and owners to ensure a reliable, evidence-based pipeline.</li> <li value="6">Contribute to improving our sales handbook and processes by documenting best practices and opportunities for refinement.</li> <li value="7">Provide account leadership and direction across pre- and post-sales, partnering closely with technical teams and customer success.</li> <li value="8">Represent the voice of the customer by contributing product feedback and ideas to our public issue tracker.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Proven success in software sales, ideally in a Enterprise market context, managing a varied book of business.</li> <li value="2">Ability to guide customers through the full buying journey, including defining buying criteria, mapping buying processes, and driving clear next steps.</li> <li value="3">Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with business development, marketing, technical teams, and sales management.</li> <li value="4">Experience documenting and maintaining accurate pipeline data and account plans based on evidence rather than assumptions.</li> <li value="5">Skill in conducting and contributing to win/loss and root cause analyses, and sharing insights to improve team performance and processes.</li> <li value="6">Proficiency in negotiation, presenting to customer stakeholders, and leading commercial discussions to close opportunities.</li> <li value="7">Interest in GitLab, open source software, and preferably familiarity with Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management.</li> <li value="8">Alignment with GitLab’s values and an interest in contributing from diverse or transferable sales backgrounds, with willingness to travel in line with company policy.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Commercial & Enterprise Sales team focuses on helping growing organizations adopt and expand GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform across their software delivery lifecycle. You’ll join a distributed group of Account Executives, sales managers, and business development team members who collaborate asynchronously across regions to manage a broad book of business in the mid-market segment. We partner closely with marketing, sales development, and technical teams to run an efficient, transparent sales process, document what works in our sales handbook, and represent the voice of the customer back into GitLab. We focus on opportunities like supporting customers through toolchain consolidation, driving platform adoption, and sharing learnings from wins and losses to continuously improve how we sell and support GitLab.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(236, 240, 241);">#LI-CW1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Vulnerability, Accessibility & Inclusion Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br>This role is a 13 month secondment to cover caregiver leave within our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team in Customer Operations.</p> <p><strong>Our VAIB team⭐</strong></p> <p>Making money work for everyone is what we do at Monzo, but it only counts if it works for the people who need support the most. Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>As our <strong>VAIB Strategy Lead</strong>, you’ll set direction within your area of expertise and turn VAIB priorities into sustainable, well-governed improvements across Monzo.You’ll bring together regulatory requirements, customer insight, data and operational experience to understand where change is needed and help the business deliver it effectively. You’ll work closely with Strategy Managers and Analysts, Operations leaders, Product, Risk, Compliance, Data, Engineering and teams across Monzo. You’ll make sure our strategic priorities are understood, appropriately governed and translated into measurable improvements for customers.</p> <ul> <li>Leading the development, integration and embedment of VAIB strategies, standards and regulatory expectations across Monzo’s products, customer journeys and operational processes. Turning the strategy into clear roadmaps, outcomes and priorities, giving strategic direction to the teams responsible for delivering them.</li> <li>Assessing our products, services and customer support against relevant legal, regulatory and industry standards, identifying gaps, risks and opportunities and driving improvements. As well as horizon scanning, regulatory analysis and gap assessments, turning emerging legal, regulatory and industry developments into practical recommendations for Monzo.</li> <li>Acting as a senior subject matter expert on complex vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion and bereavement issues, including situations where there isn’t an established answer, whilst building VAIB capability across Monzo by sharing your expertise, coaching colleagues and supporting the development of Strategy Managers and Analysts.</li> <li>Working closely with first and second line Risk and Compliance teams to understand regulatory expectations, strengthen governance and controls, and make sure VAIB risks are identified and managed appropriately. Whilst taking ownership of significant VAIB risks, controls, formal actions or remediation programmes where needed, making sure activity is delivered to the right standard.</li> <li>Setting clear expectations and measures for customer outcomes, using data and insight to understand whether our strategies and standards are working and where our approach needs to change.</li> <li>Work closely with Operations and Senior Operations leaders to improve customer support pathways, service standards and outcomes, constructively challenging where performance or strategic alignment falls short.</li> <li>Using complaints, customer insight, operational data and other relevant information to identify systemic barriers or poorer outcomes and turn those findings into strategic action.</li> <li>Working with Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance and other teams to make sure VAIB priorities are understood and embedded in the way we design, deliver and improve products and services.</li> <li>Providing strategic direction on customer communications linked to VAIB, helping make sure information is clear, accessible, accurate and consistent with our approach.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have deep expertise in vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion and bereavement, and understand how to identify and reduce barriers that can prevent people from accessing products and services.</li> <li>You have strong knowledge of the legal, regulatory and industry standards relevant to VAIB, such as FG21, Consumer Duty, the Equality Act 2010, WCAG and the European Accessibility Act, and can turn regulatory requirements, customer insight, data and operational experience into clear strategic priorities and practical recommendations.</li> <li>You have experience developing and embedding strategy at scale, including setting outcomes, roadmaps and measures of success.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working with Risk and Compliance teams and have experience identifying and managing risks, controls, governance requirements or remediation activity.</li> <li>You can provide credible challenge and influence senior stakeholders, including when an issue is complex, ambiguous or there isn’t an established solution.</li> <li>You have experience using customer and operational insight to identify systemic issues and improve customer outcomes.</li> <li>You can work effectively across different teams and disciplines, bringing people together around a clear strategic direction.</li> <li>You enjoy sharing your expertise and helping others build their capability.</li> <li>You’re excited about what we’re doing at Monzo and want to help us make money work for everyone.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £68,400-86,550 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call (25 minutes)</li> <li>Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)</li> <li>Technical interview with a task (60 minutes)<strong><br><br></strong></li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a><br><br></p> <p>The closing date for applications is 21st October 2026. However, we'll close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-REMOTE<strong> </strong><strong><br><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Data Director, EU
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London, Barcelona, or UK Remote | 💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options & <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a> | ✅ Visa sponsorship & relocation available</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About our Data Discipline </strong></p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.</p> <p>Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.</p> <p> </p> <h4><strong>Our EU team ⭐</strong></h4> <p>Our EU Data team is a full-stack Data team, and together we're building Monzo's presence across Europe from the ground up. We're entering new markets, learning what customers in each one need and finding product-market fit for Monzo. </p> <p> </p> <p>Our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. As Data Director for EU expansion you'll lead the Data team and shape our product strategy as we grow, deciding where we place our bets, working out what to measure before there's a playbook, and making sure each new market learns fast enough to compound into the next.</p> <p> </p> <p>You'll work closely with EU leadership (our EU CEO, Country Managers and VP of Product) and Monzo's global Leadership team (the CTO, Head of Data and other Data Directors), sitting on the EU Tech Leadership team and helping shape our global data strategy. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.</p> <p><em>Shaping product and commercial strategy:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.</li> <li>You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.</li> </ul> <p><em>Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.</li> <li>Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.</li> </ul> <p><em>Changing how decisions get made:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.</li> <li>You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.</li> </ul> <p><em>Building and leading a high-performing team:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where everyone shares accountability for product and business outcomes.</li> <li>You'll raise the performance bar, develop the next generation of Data leaders, and model an inclusive, high-craft Data culture as we scale.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <p>What we're doing here at Monzo excites you, and the idea of helping take it across Europe especially so!</p> <ul> <li>You're a strategic data leader who has operated at Director level or above, and you're energised by zero-to-one ambiguity, having built or scaled a data function in a new market, product line or business from an early stage.</li> <li>You move comfortably from detailed metrics and data architecture to customer strategy, commercial outcomes and product-market fit, and out, and you have experience of the cross-collective collaboration that connects the dots across different business areas.</li> <li>You're an empathetic people leader who has grown full-stack Data title: Product Manager - Auth
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Product Manager for Supabase Auth https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth. You'll own the surface area that developers use to authenticate and authorize their end users and manage identity in their apps: email, phone and social login, passkeys and MFA https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/auth-mfa, enterprise SSO, the OAuth 2.1 server https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/oauth-server, auth hooks, and support for organizations and multi-tenant applications. You'll work closely with the Auth engineering team and with partners across Product Management, Security, Design and GTM. This role is ideal for someone who’s excited about building tools for millions of developers and who has a strong understanding of existing and emerging authentication practices and protocols. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - You'll collaborate with customers of all sizes and expertise levels. Indie developers shipping a side project, startups choosing their first auth stack, SaaS teams designing multi-tenant access, and enterprises in security review. - You'll own the problem statements and solution rationale behind the Auth roadmap. This means working with Engineering and Design to shape how Supabase crafts the developer experience for the problems you’ve prioritized solving. - You'll define how Auth works for AI agents on Supabase: agents that sign users up, act on their behalf, and call APIs. - You'll use data to understand how Supabase developers are using Auth features: where they succeed, where they get stuck, and what to tackle first. - You'll keep Engineering, Design and GTM aligned. You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE - 5+ years of Product Management experience on developer tools, or are an ex-founder with equivalent depth. You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc, following a design discussion, and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required. - Have shipped standards-based auth or identity products. You've owned OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SCIM, sessions or token design, and you know from experience where each one breaks for customers. - Work comfortably with corporate buyers and with developers. You can work through a CISO's security review and an indie developer's bug report in the same week. You have intuition on which enterprise asks are real value-adding requirements and which are checkbox items. - Are comfortable with Postgres and familiar with row-level security. - Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings. STRONG SIGNAL - Owned auth or identity inside an integrated cloud platform. - Ran an organizations, tenancy, or SSO+SCIM launch from start to finish. - Designed auth for agents or other automated systems: OAuth for MCP clients, machine-to-machine credentials, scoped tokens. - Shipped something using Supabase. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
